name: Cords Cable Industries Ltd
tagline: Small-cap power-cable manufacturer with above-industry revenue growth and low leverage, but commoditised margins under pressure and a ~19x P/E leave it a fair-not-cheap story.
business_overview: Cords Cable Industries Ltd (BSE: CORDSCABLE, 532941) manufactures power, control and instrumentation cables for the domestic T&D, industrial and infrastructure segments. Seeded via untrusted-X triage (@rajuidesai, 2026-09-13, no thesis detail given).
fundamentals_table: CAGR ~13.55% vs industry median 6.51%; FY26 revenue Rs 958.9 Cr, profit +40.6% to Rs 20.6 Cr
fundamentals_narrative: Cords Cable is growing faster than the cable-industry median and is reasonably (not aggressively) levered, benefiting from India's power T&D and renewable-grid capex cycle. But a recent Q3 FY26 result showed margin pressure despite revenue growth (per MarketsMojo), and ROE of 10.7% against a ~19x P/E is not obviously cheap for a business in a largely commoditised, low-pricing-power segment.
technical_read: Stock well off its 52-week high (Rs 395.1) versus low (Rs 126.5) - wide range, no further TA pulled this pass.
sentiment_summary: No forum check performed - four_box score 2.0 (2.0-2.5 band defaults to neither) and recent margin pressure did not support an explicit exception.
bull_case: Sector tailwind from India's power T&D/renewable-grid capex cycle
bear_case: Q3 FY26 showed margin pressure despite revenue growth
Cable manufacturing is largely commoditised with limited pricing power/moat
ROE only 10.7% against a ~19x P/E - fair value, not a bargain
verdict_headline: Faster-than-industry growth and reasonable leverage, but margin pressure and a full-ish multiple - four_box score 2.0, defaults to neither.

conviction Low-Medium - untrusted X seed, decent growth but no moat/margin support for a bigger call
